copy_limits.unit_note: Words unless stated. Lines measured at 360px mobile width. Overruns are findings for the copywriter.
copy_limits.h1: 65 characters max (brief H1 is 65; do not lengthen)
copy_limits.hero_quick_answer: 3 lines max: 3 sentences, each 25 words or fewer, total 60 words max, plain text
copy_limits.hero_buttons: 28 characters each ('Find your region in Portugal' 28, 'Speak with a Wedded Advisor' 27)
copy_limits.region_card_lines: Setting 12 words; Best months 8 words; Nearest airport 6 words; Guests line omitted or 'Ask your Wedded Advisor'
copy_limits.region_card_extra_line: 30 words (Algarve beach line, Lisbon or Algarve council space)
copy_limits.palace_rules_strip: 3 lines, 30 words each, 90 words total plus one source link
copy_limits.reason_card: title 40 characters, body 30 words, one sourced fact
copy_limits.s5_cost_fallback: 60 words plus the enquiry text link
copy_limits.s6_intro: 40 words; list items 12 words each, 7 items max
copy_limits.s10_how_it_works_step: title 30 characters, body 25 words, 3 or 4 steps
copy_limits.faq_answer: first sentence 30 words or fewer and answers alone; whole answer 80 words (FAQ 2, three passports, 110 words)

scores.summary: Outline fits T2 and reuses existing blocks. Main fixes are copy-only: hero order so buttons sit above the fold, a mandatory hero line naming Wedded Concierge and one Wedded Advisor, sticky bar copy with no price, B9 carrying answers into the form, text links to #enquire in the Costs and legal tabs, a closing CTA after the FAQ, and form labels, states and hidden fields. Two brief conflicts with decisions: FAQ 5 (D9) and the fees-in-your-currency line (D10).

findings.issue: Primary CTA is unlikely to sit in the first mobile screen. The hero stacks a 65-character H1 (3 lines at 360px), a 3-line quick answer, a passport text link, the celebrations line and the brand entity sentence before the two buttons, then B9. On a 390 x 844 viewport with the 70px sticky header the buttons fall below the first screen.
findings.evidence: Brief s1-hero must_answer lists buttons last; AU persona 'Skims on a phone at 10pm'; reference template header is sticky at 70px.
findings.suggested_fix: Copy order inside the hero: H1, quick answer (3 lines), the two buttons, then the passport text link, then the brand entity sentence, then the celebrations line (or move the celebrations line to s9, which already covers it). Respect copy_limits.hero_* so the buttons stay above the fold.

findings.issue: The end-to-end offer and the one Wedded Advisor are first explained in s6 and s10, roughly 2,000 words down on mobile. The brief makes the hero placement optional ('here or in s10'). The primary persona checks scope and who will plan it before scrolling to the form.
findings.evidence: Brief s1-hero: 'Brand entity sentence here or in s10'; intl persona conversion_threshold 'scope, proof and fee structure are clear'; AU persona top question 'Who would actually plan this with us?'.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the brand entity sentence mandatory in s1 (keep it in s10 too, identical wording): 'Wedded Concierge plans weddings in Portugal for couples from Australia, the United States and the United Kingdom, with one Wedded Advisor from first enquiry to the wedding weekend.' Add one short line to the s2 intro: 'Not sure which region? Your Wedded Advisor helps you choose.'

findings.issue: The brief gives no copy for the sticky mobile bar. The reference bar shows 'From AUD 38,550 | Enquire'; this page must carry no From price, so the bar would either break or show an empty price slot.
findings.evidence: Reference index.html line 870 sticky-cta with a From price; brief s1 'No From price or any cost figure'; add-cost-bands 'No From AUD price on this page'.
findings.suggested_fix: Sticky bar copy: left label 'Wedding in Portugal' (small line: 'One Wedded Advisor'), button 'Enquire' linking to #enquire. No price slot. Hide the bar while the B3 form is in view.

findings.issue: 'Check your date' does not match what the bar asks (season, guests, celebration, no date) and sets an expectation of an instant availability answer that the page cannot give. The brief also says B9 'submits to the Wedded Concierge route', but B9 has no name or email, so it cannot create an enquiry.
findings.evidence: Brief b9-qualifier must_answer; reference form requires first_name, last_name, email.
findings.suggested_fix: B9 should carry its three answers into the B3 form (prefill) and scroll to #enquire, not submit. Button label 'Start your enquiry' (or, if the B9 label is fixed in the CMS block, keep 'Check your date' and add a helper line 'Your Wedded Advisor confirms dates and venues with you.'). Project Lead to choose.

findings.location: s11-faq heading and position; closing CTA
findings.issue: The FAQ is titled 'Get Answers Before You Enquire' but sits after the form, so on mobile the couple reaches the form, then the answers, then articles and Europe thumbnails with no route back. The brief link_plan names a closing CTA but no section carries one.
findings.evidence: section_outline order s10 (form) then s11 (FAQ); link_plan /wonderland-concierge placement 'closing CTA'.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the order (copy scope). Rename the H2 to 'Your Questions about a Wedding in Portugal' and add a closing CTA line directly after the last FAQ: 'Still deciding? Tell us your region, guest count and ceremony type.' with the button 'Speak with a Wedded Advisor' to #enquire.

findings.issue: The tabs block is the longest stretch of the page (about 1,000+ words) with no enquiry route. Until Nic signs off, the Costs tab shows only cost drivers with no figures, so the AU couple's first question ('What does this cost all in?') has no answer and no next step.
findings.evidence: add-cost-bands fallback 'explain what drives cost ... and offer a Wedded Advisor estimate'; AU persona turn-off 'No price signal at all'.
findings.suggested_fix: End the Costs tab and the Marrying legally tab with one text link each to #enquire: Costs 'Ask your Wedded Advisor for an estimate for your guest count, region and season'; Marrying legally 'Ask your Wedded Advisor which route suits your passport'. No currency or fee wording (D10).

findings.location: s10-advisor fee line; persona_questions intl and discerning-skeptic
findings.issue: The brief's fallback 'a Wedded Advisor explains fees in your currency on the first call' is itself a fee and currency claim, which D10 forbids. The skeptic mapping relies on 's10 only with an approved service line' and the s6 'on-the-day coordinator' for 'what happens if something goes wrong', which D10 also rules out as a service promise.
findings.evidence: decisions.md D10; brief s10-advisor must_answer bullet 5; persona_questions discerning-skeptic.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the fees-in-your-currency line from s10. s10 describes the steps and the one Wedded Advisor only. Keep 'an on-the-day coordinator' in s6 only as 'a weekend can include', never as a Wedded Concierge guarantee. Record the fee, currency and on-the-day questions as known persona gaps (already going to the user per D10).

findings.issue: The brief still lists 'Is a wedding in Portugal cheaper than at home?', which D9 replaces with 'When can you get married in Portugal?'.
findings.suggested_fix: SEO Strategist to swap FAQ 5 in the brief before the copywriter starts, so FAQ wording and FAQPage schema match.

findings.issue: Against the AI Overview and ChatGPT closing pattern (region, guest count, budget, legal or symbolic) the B3 set covers region and ceremony type, but guest count is not listed in the B3 bullet and budget is missing. The reference form has a numeric guests field and a specific wedding date, while B9 uses guest bands and seasons, so prefilled values would not map.
findings.evidence: 11-ai-search.json: 'ChatGPT ended 6 of 7 answers by asking region, guest count, budget and legal or symbolic ceremony'; reference form fields guests (number), wedding_date, date_flexible.
findings.suggested_fix: Visible fields: First name, Last name, Email, Phone (optional), Region (select), Season (select, same options as B9), Guests (select, same bands as B9), Celebration (select, same as B9), Ceremony type (select, optional), Anything we should know? (textarea). Replace wedding_date and date_flexible with Season plus an optional 'Year' select (reason: couples at 1 to 3 out of 10 rarely have a date; B9 prefill must map). Destination 'Portugal' becomes a hidden field, not a visible one. Budget: no new field; the textarea placeholder reads 'Budget, dates you have in mind, anything else'. Form intro: 'Tell us your region, guest count and whether you want a legal or symbolic ceremony, and a Wedded Advisor will reply.'

findings.issue: Guest bands are left to UX and the celebration list includes honeymoon, anniversary and proposal, for which ceremony type does not apply.
findings.evidence: Brief b9-qualifier 'Bands (UX to set; include an under 30 band)'; AU persona guests typically 31 to 80; intl persona 40 to 150.
findings.suggested_fix: Guest bands (B9 and B3): 'Under 30', '30 to 60', '61 to 100', '101 to 150', 'Over 150', 'Not sure yet'. Celebration: Wedding, Elopement, Vow renewal, Honeymoon, Anniversary, Proposal, Something else. Ceremony type options: 'Legal civil ceremony in Portugal', 'Catholic ceremony', 'Another faith', 'Symbolic (marry legally at home)', 'No ceremony', 'Not sure yet'. 'Another faith' reflects civil marriage in religious form (F029) without stating a rule in the form.

findings.location: B3 region select vs s2 card titles
findings.issue: Select options ('Lisbon and Sintra', 'Algarve', 'Porto and Douro', 'Comporta and Alentejo') differ from the card titles. Region card CTAs prefill the select, so labels and values must match exactly.
findings.evidence: Brief s10-advisor B3 vs s2-regions card titles.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the card titles as option labels: 'Lisbon, Sintra and Cascais', 'The Algarve', 'Porto and the Douro Valley', 'Comporta and the Alentejo', 'Madeira' (pending doc q7), 'Not sure yet'. Card CTA labels until child pages are live: 'Ask about Lisbon and Sintra', 'Ask about the Algarve', 'Ask about the Douro', 'Ask about Comporta', 'Ask about Madeira'.

findings.issue: The brief gives no labels for the new selects, no error messages, no consent line and no success state.
findings.evidence: Checklist item 6; brief s10-advisor only gives options and the button 'Send your enquiry'.
findings.suggested_fix: Labels as in UX09. Errors: 'Please add your first name', 'Please add your last name', 'Please add an email we can reply to'. Consent line under the button: 'We use your details only to reply to your enquiry. See our Privacy Policy.' Success: heading 'Thank you', body 'Your enquiry is with Wedded Concierge. A Wedded Advisor will be in touch to talk through your Portugal plans.' No reply-time promise (no approved service line, D10).

findings.issue: Hidden fields are not specified. Without them enquiries cannot be routed or attributed.
findings.evidence: Checklist item 4; config.json enquiry_endpoint /api/concierge/enquiry, enquiry_route wedded-concierge; reference form hidden fields route_to, offer, package, package_url.
findings.suggested_fix: Post to /api/concierge/enquiry with hidden fields: route_to=wedded-concierge, destination=Portugal, page_slug=/destinations/europe/portugal, offer=(region chosen from a card CTA, else blank), entry_point=(hero, b9, region-card, tab-link, closing, sticky), utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content captured from the URL. Record in CMS-HANDOFF.md. Resolved at Stage 4 or CMS handoff; does not block brief approval.

findings.issue: With B8 numbers unsigned, the founder quote removed and s8 hidden, the page has almost no proof before the form. The primary persona 'checks proof before scrolling to the form'.
findings.evidence: Brief b8 fallback 'or hide the strip'; s8 hidden (2 of 3); intl persona reading_behaviour.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not hide B8: use the non-numeric fallback ('Planned by Wedded Concierge, with one Wedded Advisor from enquiry to the wedding weekend'). Show the Europe real weddings strip in place of s8 as the brief allows. Visible proof on the page itself: the October 2026 freshness line and official sources in the tabs.

findings.issue: Seven tabs with labels up to 28 characters ('Marrying legally by passport') will need horizontal scrolling on mobile, and the legal tab may sit off-screen.
findings.evidence: Brief s5-plan tab list; reference tabs are a sticky strip.
findings.suggested_fix: Tab labels max 16 characters: 'When to go', 'Getting there', 'Entry rules', 'Marrying legally', 'Costs', 'Timeline', 'Your weekend'. Keep 'by passport' in each panel's first heading. Keep the anchor #marrying-legally for the hero link.

findings.issue: The Wonderland Studio button sends couples to another product before they reach the form.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep it, but as the secondary button style with a qualifier: 'Build a guest website' label is clearer, or keep 'Start for free' preceded by 'Guest website in Wonderland Studio:'. Never a filled primary button.

findings.issue: Heading casing is inconsistent ('Plan your Portugal Wedding, Step by Step', 'Read More about Weddings in Portugal'). Palace rules strip and venue charges box have no heading level set.
findings.suggested_fix: Use one casing style: 'Plan Your Portugal Wedding, Step by Step'. Palace strip and venue charges box use H3 inside their H2 sections; tab panels H3; B1, B14, B2 and B3 H3 under the s10 H2. One H1, no skipped levels.

results.check: 1 Reuses reference template components; new components justified
results.detail: T2 country template adapted per intake; uses existing WW blocks B1, B2, B3, B6, B7, B8, B9, B14, B16. Page-specific additions are strips or boxes inside existing sections, recorded in intake. Reference package page used for form and sticky bar patterns.

results.check: 2 Primary CTA visible in the first screen on mobile, and a sticky mobile enquire bar
results.detail: Hero order puts buttons below the first screen and the sticky bar has no copy (it would inherit a From price slot). Fixes in UX01 and UX03; both are copy-only.

results.check: 3 End-to-end offer and contact person explained before the form
results.detail: s6 weekend and s10 B1 and B14 come before B3, so it is explained before the form, but late (about 2,000 words down). UX02 makes the hero line mandatory.

results.check: 4 Form posts to config enquiry_endpoint with route_to, offer, page slug and UTM hidden fields
results.detail: Not specified in the brief. Full hidden field list supplied in UX13 for CMS-HANDOFF and the Stage 4 spec. Explained in open_questions.

results.check: 5 Form fields kept to the reference set unless a reason is recorded
results.detail: Adds region, ceremony type, celebration and season; reason recorded (AI answer closing pattern, B9 prefill, early-stage couples without a date). Destination moved to a hidden field. See UX09.

results.check: 6 Every field labelled, error and success states specified
results.detail: Brief has options only. Labels, errors, consent and success copy supplied in UX09 and UX12.

results.check: 7 Tap targets 44px or more, WCAG AA contrast
results.detail: Layout and components unchanged (copy scope), so template sizing and contrast carry over. Copy limits keep buttons to one line at 360px. QA to confirm B9 option chips and FAQ accordion rows are 44px or more on the preview.

results.check: 8 Heading order logical (one H1, no skipped levels)
results.detail: One H1, H2 per section, B8 and B9 without headings. Casing fix and H3 levels for strips, tabs and s10 sub-blocks in UX17.

results.check: 9 Copy length limits set per component; overruns flagged
results.detail: Brief set none beyond title, meta and FAQ first sentence. Full copy_limits object in payload.scores.copy_limits; copywriter overruns become findings at Stage 3 review.

assumptions: First-screen judgement uses a 390 x 844 mobile viewport with the 70px sticky header from the reference template; the live hero image height is unknown (no raw HTML of the live page).
The T2 hub reuses the reference package page's sticky-cta and form components, as the brief does not name different ones.
B9 is a CMS block whose button label can be edited as copy; if not, the helper line in UX04 applies.
A generic consent line pointing to the existing Privacy Policy is acceptable; legal wording is for the Project Lead to confirm.
Guest bands are set from persona guest ranges (AU 31 to 80 typical, intl 40 to 150) plus the under-30 elopement band the brief asks for.

open_questions.question: Checklist item 4 (blocker) is failed only because the brief cannot carry form plumbing. Approve the hidden field list in UX13 for CMS-HANDOFF.md, so it is resolved at Stage 4 without blocking the brief?
B9 button: replace 'Check your date' with 'Start your enquiry', or keep the template label with the helper line (UX04)?
Swap FAQ 5 per D9 and remove the 'fees in your currency' fallback from s10 per D10 (UX07, UX08) before the copywriter starts?
Replace the reference form's wedding date and 'dates flexible' fields with Season plus an optional Year so B9 values prefill cleanly (UX09)?
